author: Minecraft
description: There's so much to do in Minecraft that even Jeb hasn't done it all! In fact, there is one particular challenge he hasn’t taken on – at least not in this way. Will he succeed in his somewhat eccentric yet oddly entertaining adventure to find the elytra? Or give up halfway due to crouching-induced hand pain? Why would he need to crouch so much anyway? Watch and find out!
title: JEB'S BIGGEST CHALLENGE EVER  | Spawn Point Stories
